scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Backward intertwiners and a transitive commutant” (preprints/Backward-intertwiners-and-a-transitive-commutant-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 293 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 793876a758c32d9e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are measurable positive weights βj : X → (0, ∞), j ∈ Z, and a contraction V ∈ B(H0) with the following properties. The shifts Sxej = βj(x)ej+1, (Sf)(x) = Sxf(x), define a bounded operator S on H0, and: 1. For every x ∈ X, the closed invariant subspaces of Sx are exactly K≥h, h ∈ Z ∪ {−∞, +∞}. 2. The operator S is nonzero, ∥S∥ = e−10, and for every integer n ≥ 1, ∥Sn ∥ ≤ exp ( −10 ⌊ (n + 1)2 4 ⌋) . (1) 3. The operator V commutes with S and has the form (V f)(θx) = Vxf(x), Vxej = bj(x)ej−1, where 0 ≤ bj(x) ≤ 1 are measurable and are positive on a common conull set. On that set, VxK≥h = K≥h−1 (h ∈ Z), VxK = K. 4. The unital complex algebra generated by S, V , and all scalar multipliers Mg is transitive.
